2105-7296-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-7296-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-7296-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1981-2415-6823-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6823-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1671-2085-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
1671-2085-2645-3430.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

654-1021-1669-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

141-4247-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4247-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

5686-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

728-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

1003-2626-4986-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4013-7133.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Doctor Doom.
When Doctor Doom enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4050-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1020-2866-4050-7693.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {1}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Repeat.

1362-1479-4488.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

360-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3581-4478-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-4478-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

4771-5660-6556.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1887-4772-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Doubling Season and Vorinclex, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

515-1636-5259.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Rude Awakening.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1863-4377-4423-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
1863-4377-4423-6886.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos

333-4775-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

474-643-4050-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Maskwood Nexus by paying {4}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {1}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

619-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.

Activate Dormant Volcano and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Dormant Volcano and another land.
Activate Dormant Volcano and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

144-628-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

939-1003-1636-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Soul Foundry does not have summoning sickness.
Phyrexian Walker exiled by Soul Foundry.
939-1003-1636-4694.description:
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Walker
When the Phyrexian Walker token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4559-4740-5491-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-5491-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a Map and a Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure and Map, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2914-5673.description: Because Harbinger of the Seas causes all nonbasic lands to be Islands, and Choke prevents Islands from untapping during their controller's untap steps, nonbasic lands do not untap during their controller's untap steps.

2527-4073-4076-4549-5635.notablePrerequisites: Burakos does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-4073-4076-4549-5635.description:
Cast Demon's Disciple by paying {2}{B}.
When Demon's Disciple enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding {B}.
Burakos triggers, giving it and all creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Demon's Disciple trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice Burakos, and each opponent to sacrifice a creature or planeswalker.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos, giving Demon's Disciple -1/-1 until end of turn.
Demon's Disciple dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 one additional time.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos and Demon's Disciple, giving Demon's Disciple -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 8.

77-1304-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature, artifact, or land that can produce at least {2}.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
77-1304-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Nature's Chosen attached to Yenna, untapping Yenna, and scrying 2.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's second ability by tapping Yenna, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Yenna.
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing the Nature's Chosen token, gaining 1 life.
Repeat any number of times.
If the mana-producing permanent can produce at least {3}, this combo produces infinite mana that artifacts, creatures, and lands you control can produce.

326-3282.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Quandrix Pledgemage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

2499-3657-4022.description:
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

7-678-1872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature except Composite Golem with a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-678-1872.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying at most {5}.
Repeat.
If you control two or more creatures with +1/+1 counters, this combo will net infinite colored mana.

372-4050-4783.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
